dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Multiple system atrophy, cerebellar type (MSA-C) – a sporadic α-synucleinopathy producing progressive isolated cerebellar atrophy with superimposed parkinsonian rigidity and gait disorder
Spinocerebellar ataxia (e.g., SCA2, SCA3, or SCA6 – de novo mutation or with reduced penetrance) – would require an ataxia gene panel / next-generation sequencing
Idiopathic (sporadic) adult-onset cerebellar ataxia of unknown etiology – a diagnosis of exclusion after genetic and extended autoimmune/paraneoplastic workup is negative
Autoimmune or paraneoplastic cerebellar ataxia (e.g., anti-mGluR1, anti-Homer-3, anti-Sj/ITPR1, anti-Ca/ARHGAP26, anti-KLHL11, anti-DNER, anti-PCA-2, anti-GAD at high titre, anti-Yo, anti-Hu, anti-Ri, anti-Tr, anti-Zic, anti-SOX1, anti-CV2, anti-VGCC, anti-Nb/AP3B2, anti-Septin-5/7, anti-MAP1B, anti-NCDN) – would require extended serum/CSF antibody panels and whole-body FDG-PET CT for occult malignancy
